_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: naming/refreshing who the brand's competitors are. Should-not-trigger: researching the ads competitors run (researching-competitor-ads), analyzing the user's own brand (analyzing-brand), planning campaigns (planning-campaigns), and an off-topic control. Bare 'competitor(s)' is deliberately NOT a keyword — researching-competitor-ads already claims it.
